inbound_dir.description: Directory containing inbound .pkt files to be tossed.

outbound_dir.description: Directory where outgoing messages are placed.

areas_dir.description: Top-level directory where message areas (JAM/MSG) are stored.

log_file.description: Path to log file, or 'syslog' to use system logging (Linux-specific).

areas.description: List of default message areas to configure. Each entry defines type, path, and optional auto-add parameters.

areas.items.name.description: Identifier for the area (used in comments only).

areas.items.path.description: Filesystem path to the message area.

areas.items.auto_add.description: Optional auto-add configuration for MSG/JAM areas.

areas.items.auto_add.use_8dot3.description: If true, use %8 path format (Linux: 8-digit serial numbers); overrides path_format if true.

areas.items.auto_add.path_format.description: Custom format string for auto-add (e.g. %A-%Y); ignored if use_8dot3 is true.

links.items.address.description: Address string to send mail to for this node (e.g. 'fido net').

system_name.description: Name of the FTS-0001 system (SYSTM field).

system_location.description: Physical location of the system (SYSTM field).

remote_passwords.description: Passwords for remote nodes, used when sending INFO/LIST/QUERY messages.

security_enabled.description: If false, enables NOSECURITY mode (process packets without security checks).
